name: Immersive Villagers
description: This addon gives the villagers the ability to learn, adapt, build and talk to players! It uses a local Backend system that can take raw information from the game (example: events, what the villager sees via raycasting to identify structures, chat messages, etc.) and identify patterns like a real human, a lightweight LLM (llama.cpp) ran locally for reasoning and chatting and A local database to store villager memories. you need to install Postgresql for database and Express.js for this addon to fully work.
